name: Cream of Rice Hot Cereal (The Acute Flare Breakfast Gold Standard)
whyItWorks: The single safest breakfast on earth during an acute Crohn's or Colitis flare. Made exclusively of finely granulated white rice enriched with iron and B vitamins. It has 0g fiber, is naturally gluten-free, non-allergenic, and digests into pure soothing glucose without any mechanical work from the bowel.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Whisk 1/4 cup Cream of Rice into 1 cup boiling water or lactose-free milk for 2.5 minutes until thick and creamy. Sweeten with a drizzle of pure maple syrup or stir in a spoonful of smooth creamy peanut butter.
watchOuts: Practically zero GI risk; use water or lactose-free milk during acute inflammation.
